title: security: rbac v2 - KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Enhances RBAC v2 enforcement to support KMS region pinning and richer audit logging of KMS key usage and residency decisions. Includes migration tool, tests, and docs. No API surface breaking changes for existing customers unless they enable strict residency enforcement.
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require (1) strong guarantees that keys and decrypted payloads do not leave permitted regions and (2) auditable trails tied to RBAC decisions. This PR extends RBAC v2 to propagate KMS region pinning constraints through policy evaluation and records structured audit events for KMS operations.

What this PR does: Adds policy schema extensions for kms_region and residency_mode, enforcement hooks in the KMS client that reject operations when region pinning constraints are violated, and audit event enrichment to capture the policy decision, key metadata, and resolution path. Also includes a small migration CLI to add default region_pinning policies for tenants opting into residency enforcement, updated unit and integration tests, and docs.

Key implementation notes: - Policy validator now understands new fields: "kms_region" (string | list) and "residency_mode" (audit|enforce). Policies with residency_mode=enforce will result in hard rejections at call time; audit mode will log but allow. - KMS client checks the request region against the evaluated policy and emits Audit.KMS.Access events with fields: decision, matched_policy_id, key_arn, requested_region, resolved_region, and tenant_id. - Added a compact migration tool (cmd/rbac-migrate) that safely converts legacy residency flags into RBAC v2 policies and prints a dry-run report. - Backwards compatibility: systems that do not opt into residency enforcement behave unchanged; audit-only mode is opt-in.

Migration steps: 1) Run the migration tool with --dry-run to review proposed policies. 2) Apply new policies for tenants that require residency enforcement. 3) Toggle residency_mode from audit->enforce during a maintenance window if desired. Rollback: remove or set policies to residency_mode=audit.

Testing and verification: Unit tests for policy validator and KMS guard (new table-driven tests). Integration tests simulate multi-region requests and assert proper audit events are emitted to the audit pipeline. Local e2e harness validated that existing streaming/generation paths see no latency regression beyond noise. Performance: a microbenchmark shows ~0.2ms median added latency for policy evaluation in enforced paths.

Security review: Design reviewed by Security and Compliance (see linked_linear SEC-9876). Audit schema changes were approved and added to the audit event contract.

Notes for reviewers: Focus on policy evaluation correctness (policy ordering, wildcard matching), audit event completeness (fields required for forensic investigations), and migration CLI safety.

squash! security: rbac v2 - kms region pinning + audit logging enhancements

Adds policy schema extensions, enforcement hooks in KMS client, enriched audit events, migration tool, tests, and docs.
notes_for_ops: Deployment ordering: 1) deploy policy validator and KMS guard code to all regions (canary 10% traffic). 2) run rbac-migrate with --dry-run, review output, then apply policies. 3) enable residency_mode=enforce for targeted tenants during maintenance window. Monitoring: watch audit pipeline for Audit.KMS.Access events and increase alert sensitivity for decision="enforce_reject". If issues, set residency_mode back to audit and roll back migration policies.
